overview.heading: Master Maritime Strategy Development for Africa
overview.intro: For decades, the African continent has faced a wide range of maritime security threats and challenges. This comprehensive course equips professionals with the knowledge, skills, and tools necessary to develop and implement effective maritime strategies within the African context.
objectives: Understand how maritime strategy enhances national and regional priorities
Develop maritime strategies for Africa's unique challenges
Examine features that enhance sustainability of strategies
Explore tools for implementing maritime strategies
Equip participants to contribute to strategy development
Understand implications of strategy development processes

outcomes.desc: Develop skilled actors to enhance maritime security strategy development

moduleList.title: Introduction & Maritime Strategy Theory
moduleList.description: Foundational concepts of maritime strategy, strategic thinking versus operational planning, and the maritime strategy development cycle.

moduleList.title: Assessing Maritime Domain Challenges & Opportunities
moduleList.description: Maritime threat landscape, security challenges, economic opportunities, and comprehensive maritime domain assessments.

moduleList.title: Strategy Development Process
moduleList.description: Step-by-step strategy development framework, vision and goal setting, strategic objective formulation, and policy alignment.

moduleList.title: Interagency Coordination & Stakeholder Analysis
moduleList.description: Mapping maritime stakeholders, coordination mechanisms, building partnerships, and multi-sectoral collaboration.

moduleList.title: Ends, Ways, Means & Risk
moduleList.description: Strategic framework alignment, resource mobilization, risk identification, mitigation strategies, and contingency planning.

moduleList.title: Maritime Strategy Implementation
moduleList.description: From strategy to action, implementation planning, monitoring and evaluation systems, and adaptive management.

moduleList.title: Sector Planning – In Class Exercise
moduleList.description: Practical sector planning exercise, applying strategy development frameworks, and team-based strategy development.

moduleList.title: Case Study Reports & Course Conclusion
moduleList.description: Analysis of regional maritime strategies, comparative analysis of successes and challenges, and final presentations.
